headline: Brent Crude Jumps Over 3% on Saudi Drone Attack and Smaller US Stock Build
summary: Brent crude climbed above $94 per barrel following a drone attack near a Saudi port and a lower-than-expected increase in US commercial crude inventories.
why: Geopolitical supply risks and inventory data fluctuations directly influence global oil prices, impacting energy sector equities and macroeconomic inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical disruption and tighter inventory figures drive up oil prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical supply risks in the Middle East combined with a smaller-than-forecast rise in US commercial crude inventories spurred buying interest in crude futures.
